name: Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate
blurb: The next step for Fabric work: lakehouses, warehouses, dataflows, enterprise semantic models and lifecycle management.

verified.source: Microsoft Learn study guide, updated 2026-09-18 (skills measured as of 19 October 2026)

note: DP-600 expects SQL, KQL and DAX. The SQL and Fabric tracks cover the hands-on side; Experience Mode's Fabric migration sprint covers the decisions.

versions.label: Before 19 October 2026
versions.changes: The outline in force until 18 October 2026. Same three skill areas and weights. Microsoft lists only a minor change in Query and analyze data for the new version, so the skills below apply to both, apart from small wording differences in that group.

versions.label: As of 19 October 2026
versions.changes: Minor change in Query and analyze data. The outline also distinguishes Direct Lake on OneLake from Direct Lake on SQL analytics endpoint and includes OneLake integration for Eventhouse and semantic models.
